notes.title: Update v1.1.11
notes.content:
Yamafuda! has just celebrated its first anniversary! Thank you!
We have made additions, adjustments, and fixes.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can listen to music from your Hikes! When two character hike all the mountains, it will appear on the mountain selection screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/2ae2ff08b3e9a9cbb881cad5784c544e13f3009e.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gear "Radio" Every time use 3 cards, [Excite] +1
[*] Gear "Stuff Bag" Whenever use up deck 1 time, [Quick] +1
[*] Gear "Burning" Every time life decreases, [Eager] +4
[*] Gear "Glove" If you have extra protection, Gain [Eager]
[*] Gear "Eisen" Every time get [Cold], [Excite] +3
[*] Gear "Whistle" First turn, [Step] +8
[/list]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corrected translation errors
[*] Fixed an issue that occurs when buttons are operated while switching screens
[/list]
Have a good hike!

notes.title: Released! - Yamafuda! 2nd station | Deck-building roguelike game
notes.content:
"Yamafuda! 2nd station" has been released today!
Draw a card for each station, and enjoy the mountain hiking!

[h3]"Yamafuda!" What is it?[/h3]

The main character has a slight interest in mountainhiking, and is invited by a friend to make his mountainhiking debut.
To hike a mountain, you use "cards". Each time you hike a mountain, you use a card, which is randomly generated from three cards.
When you take a break along the way, you can create "gear", which is a mountain tool. The more gear you make, the more comfortable your hike will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/b71552d7d792cdb146fd3412845f62de7e168e8d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/5cb374ab320fa2281311d152e7bfae1a5541d776.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/1923d70a1c87ded58630426f60d7549bf3d1e4aa.png[/img]

Enjoy all the sights and sounds with you two!
